units.title: Counting
units.blurb: Say the numbers in order to 5, 10 and 20, touch and count one at a time, and know that the last number tells how many.

units.title: Seeing at a Glance
units.blurb: Know small amounts without counting: dot patterns, five frames and fingers.

units.title: Numbers 0 to 10
units.blurb: Match written numbers to groups of things, meet zero, and put numbers in order.

units.title: More, Fewer, Same
units.blurb: Tell which group has more or fewer, see when two groups are the same, and add one more.

units.title: Big, Tall, Long, Heavy
units.blurb: Compare sizes, heights, lengths and weights, and measure with blocks.

units.title: Sorting
units.blurb: Sort by color, shape and size, and find the one that does not belong.

units.title: Patterns
units.blurb: Find what comes next in AB, AAB and ABC patterns.

units.title: Shapes
units.blurb: Know circles, squares, triangles and rectangles, count sides and corners, and spot shapes in real things.

units.title: Where Is It?
units.blurb: Above, below, on, under, in front, behind, beside and between.

units.title: First, Next, Last
units.blurb: Who is first and last in line, and what comes next in a story.

units.title: Adding and Taking Away
units.blurb: Put small groups together and take some away, within 5, with pictures.

units.title: Days and Routines
units.blurb: Morning, afternoon and night, and the order of things in a day.

units.title: Coins
units.blurb: Look at coins and count pennies (just for fun).

topics.title: Counting to 5
topics.short: Say the numbers 1 to 5 in order.
topics.trouble: Children skip a number or say numbers out of order.

topics.title: Touch and Count
topics.short: Say one number for each thing you touch.
topics.trouble: Children touch one thing twice or skip one.

topics.title: How Many?
topics.short: The last number you say tells how many.
topics.trouble: Asked how many, children count again instead of saying the last number.

topics.title: Counting to 10
topics.short: Say the numbers to 10, and start from any number.

topics.title: Counting Things to 10
topics.short: Count up to 10 things in rows, circles or a jumble.
topics.trouble: In a jumble, children lose track of which ones they counted.

topics.title: Find a Group of Some
topics.short: Find the group that has a number of things.

topics.title: Counting to 20
topics.short: Say the numbers to 20 and count on from 10.
topics.trouble: The teen numbers are tricky: children say "eleventeen" or skip 15.

topics.title: At a Glance: 1, 2, 3
topics.short: See 1, 2 or 3 things without counting.

topics.title: Dot Patterns and Five Frames
topics.short: Know dot patterns and five frames up to 5.

topics.title: Finger Numbers
topics.short: Show and read numbers on fingers.

topics.title: Numbers 1 to 5
topics.short: Match the numbers 1 to 5 to groups of things.

topics.title: Zero Means None
topics.short: 0 is the number for none at all.
topics.trouble: Children do not think of 0 as a number.

topics.title: Numbers 6 to 10
topics.short: Match the numbers 6 to 10 to groups of things.

topics.title: Match Number and Group
topics.short: Find the group that goes with a number.

topics.title: Numbers in Order
topics.short: Put the numbers 0 to 10 in order and find a missing one.

topics.title: Which Has More?
topics.short: Tell which group has more.
topics.trouble: Children pick the group that looks bigger or longer, not the one with more.

topics.title: Which Has Fewer?
topics.short: Tell which group has fewer.

topics.title: The Same Number
topics.short: See when two groups have the same number.

topics.title: One More
topics.short: One more is the next counting number.

topics.title: Big and Small
topics.short: Find the biggest and the smallest.

topics.title: Tall and Short
topics.short: Compare heights from the same floor.

topics.title: Long and Short
topics.short: Compare lengths from the same start line.
topics.trouble: Children compare the ends without lining up the starts.

topics.title: Heavy and Light
topics.short: Tell which is heavier or lighter, and read a balance.

topics.title: Measuring with Blocks
topics.short: Measure a length with blocks and compare.

topics.title: Sorting by Color
topics.short: Sort and count things by color.

topics.title: Sorting by Shape
topics.short: Sort and count things by shape.

topics.title: Sorting by Size
topics.short: Sort things into big and small.

topics.title: Which One Does Not Belong?
topics.short: Find the one that is not like the others.

topics.title: AB Patterns
topics.short: Find what comes next in an AB pattern.

topics.title: AAB and ABB Patterns
topics.short: Find what comes next when one part repeats twice.

topics.title: ABC Patterns
topics.short: Find what comes next in a pattern of three.

topics.title: Circles and Squares
topics.short: Know a circle and a square, even when turned.

topics.title: Triangles and Rectangles
topics.short: Know a triangle and a rectangle, even when turned.
topics.trouble: Children think a triangle must point up.

topics.title: Sides and Corners
topics.short: Count the sides and corners of a shape.

topics.title: Shapes All Around
topics.short: Find circles, triangles and rectangles in real things.

topics.title: Above, On and Under
topics.short: Say where something is: above, on or under.

topics.title: In Front and Behind
topics.short: Say where something is: in front of or behind.

topics.title: Beside and Between
topics.short: Say where something is: beside or between.

topics.title: First, Next and Last
topics.short: Who is first, next and last in line.

topics.title: What Comes Next?
topics.short: Put the steps of a little story in order.

topics.title: Putting Together
topics.short: Put two small groups together and count them all.

topics.title: Taking Away
topics.short: Take some away and count what is left.

topics.title: Morning, Afternoon and Night
topics.short: Tell the times of day from the sky.

topics.title: Our Day in Order
topics.short: Put the things we do in a day in order.

topics.title: Looking at Coins
topics.short: Look at coins and count pennies.
